newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Mandarin Com taps Nortel for HK PCS network.
newsitem.headline: Mandarin Com taps Nortel for HK PCS network.

text.p: Northern Telecom (Nortel) will supply a complete DCS 1800 network to Mandarin Communications Ltd, which recently was awarded a Personal Communications Services (PCS) license, Richard J. Siemens, Mandarin deputy chairman and managing director, said on Friday.
Northern Telecom's PCS network is valued at HK$425 million, Siemens said in a statement detailing the strategic relationship with Nortel.
PCS is a digital wireless voice and data communications standard which operates in the 1.7 Ghz to 2.0 Gz band.
The Mandarin network, which received one of six PCS licenses recently awarded in Hong Kong, will be based on the Nortel DMS SuperNode MSC. It is scheduled to begin operations in mid-1997.
Nortel will supply, install and commission complete radio, intelligent network and switching equipment systems with short message and voice message service capabilities.
Mandarin Communications is a consortium led by Lai Sun Development Co Ltd and USI Holdings Ltd.
